dashboard.empty: Surveyor has not audited your forum yet. The first audit reads your sitemap and visits your pages as a guest would, a few at a time.
dashboard.running: An audit is running: {done} of {queued} pages checked.
dashboard.frequency_daily: A new audit starts every day.
dashboard.frequency_weekly: A new audit starts every week.
dashboard.frequency_monthly: A new audit starts every month.
dashboard.frequency_manual: Audits only run when you start one.
dashboard.no_scheduler: Flarum's scheduler has not run Surveyor yet, so scheduled audits are not happening. See Diagnostics.

audit.stepping: Working in this tab. Keep it open, or let the scheduler carry on.
audit.last_stopped: Last audit was stopped {when} after {pages} pages.
audit.help: The audit runs in the background from Flarum's scheduler, at the pace set in Settings. It only visits your own forum, as a guest, and skips private pages, files and anything robots.txt or your rules keep out.

page.title: Title
page.error_timeout: The page took too long to answer
page.no_issues: Nothing to fix on this page.

issues.title_missing_fix: Every page needs a title. FoF SEO sets titles; check its settings for this kind of page.
issues.title_short_fix: Titles under 10 characters say little about the page. Rename it to describe what it is about.
issues.title_long_fix: Search engines cut titles at about 65 characters. Shorten it, or keep the important words first.
issues.description_missing_fix: Search engines then make up their own snippet. FoF SEO writes descriptions; check it is enabled for this kind of page.
issues.description_short_fix: Under 50 characters is rarely enough to make someone click. FoF SEO can be set to use more of the first post.
issues.description_long_fix: Search engines show about 160 characters. The rest is cut off.
issues.canonical_missing_fix: Without one, search engines guess which of several addresses is the real page. FoF SEO adds it.
issues.canonical_elsewhere_fix: This page tells search engines another address is the real one. That is right for copies; check it is meant here.
issues.noindex_fix: The page asks search engines not to list it (noindex). Fine for pages you mean to hide; otherwise check FoF SEO's robots settings.
issues.h1_missing_fix: The page has no h1 heading for search engines to read.
issues.h1_multiple_fix: More than one h1 heading. Usually a theme or an extension adds one; one is best.
issues.thin_content_fix: Under 50 words for a guest to read. Pages like this rarely rank; they may be empty, or hidden from guests.
issues.images_no_alt_fix: Alt text describes an image for screen readers and search engines.
issues.structured_data_missing_fix: No JSON-LD on the page. FoF SEO adds it to discussions; other pages may simply not have any.
issues.structured_data_invalid_fix: A JSON-LD block on the page cannot be read. Check which extension adds it.
issues.slow_fix: The page took over 1.5 seconds to arrive. Search engines crawl slow sites less.

duplicates.title: Same title
duplicates.help: Pages that share a title or description compete with each other in search. Pages that point their canonical at another page are left out, as they already say they are copies.

links.help: Links on your pages that lead somewhere a guest cannot simply read. "Members only" links are not broken; they work for people who are signed in.
links.explain_broken: The page is gone (404 or 410). Make a redirect to where it lives now, or remove the links.
links.explain_redirect: The link works but takes a detour. Linking to the final address directly is faster.
links.explain_restricted: Guests cannot see this page, but it exists. Search engines will not follow these links.
links.explain_challenge: A security service (like Cloudflare) showed a challenge page instead. Visitors might be stopped too.
links.explain_failed: The request failed or the server answered with an error. Recheck it later.
links.missing_help: Addresses visitors and search engines keep asking for that do not exist, from Detour's 404 log. Detour does not record who asked, so bots and people are counted together.

redirect.title: Create a Detour redirect
redirect.target_help: A path on this forum, like /d/123.
redirect.mode_missing: Only while the old address is missing
redirect.mode_missing_help: If the page ever comes back, the redirect steps aside.
redirect.mode_always_help: The redirect wins even if a page exists at the old address.

indexnow.help: IndexNow tells Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and other search engines straight away when a discussion is started, edited, renamed, hidden or deleted, instead of waiting for them to notice. Google does not use IndexNow.
indexnow.status_on: IndexNow is on. {pending} discussions are waiting to be sent.
indexnow.status_off: IndexNow is off. Nothing is sent.
indexnow.backoff: Paused until {when}: the last request was refused or failed.
indexnow.key_help: Search engines check this file to prove the forum is yours. If it does not open, see Diagnostics.
indexnow.new_key_confirm: Make a new key? The old key file stops working at once.
indexnow.manual_help: One address per line, up to 100. Only addresses on this forum that are not private are sent.
indexnow.refused: {count} refused (not on this forum, or private).
indexnow.status_403: The key was not accepted. The key file must open for everyone.
indexnow.status_422: An address does not belong to this site or does not match the key.
indexnow.status_429: Too many requests. Surveyor waits an hour.

search.help: Connect Google Search Console to see how each page does in Google search, which queries find it, whether Google has indexed it, and where the easy wins are. Surveyor reads it with a service account; see the Guide for how to make one.
search.key_keep: Leave empty to keep the key already saved
search.key_help: Paste the whole key file. It is stored encrypted and never shown again; only the account's email is.
search.property_help: As Search Console names it: sc-domain:example.com for a domain property, or https://example.com/ (with the slash) for a URL-prefix property.
search.how_to_key: How do I get a key?
search.connect_failed: Search Console could not be connected.
search.token_failed: The key was saved, but Google did not accept it. Check that the service account's key is current and the Search Console API is enabled for its project.
search.refreshed: Data refreshed {when}. It covers the 28 days that ended three days ago (Google's data is final after about three days).
search.never_refreshed: No data yet. It is fetched once a day by the scheduler, or now with Refresh.
search.paused: Paused until {when} after an error from Google: {error}
search.sitemaps_check: Check what Google knows about the sitemap
search.sitemap_known: Google knows your sitemap: last submitted {submitted}, last read {read}, {errors} errors, {warnings} warnings.
search.sitemap_unknown: Google has not been given {url} yet.
search.sitemap_submit_help: Submitting needs the service account to have Full permission on the property. Reading only needs Restricted.
search.no_pages: Search Console has no data for pages of this forum yet.
search.no_queries: No queries recorded for this page.
search.inspect_daily_cap: Today's limit of {cap} inspections is used up. It resets at midnight (UTC).
search.inspect_minute_cap: Ten inspections a minute at most. Try again in a minute.
search.inspect_paused: Google calls are paused after an error. See Diagnostics.
search.inspect_no_token: Google did not give Surveyor an access token. Check the key.

opportunities.help: Pages that could win more clicks from Google, from the last 28 days of Search Console data, with the most potential first. Potential is the extra clicks a month if the page did as well as typical pages at its position.
opportunities.empty: No opportunities yet. They need Search Console data; connect it and refresh.
opportunities.numbers: {clicks} clicks · {impressions} impressions · CTR {ctr}% · position {position} · about {potential} more clicks a month
opportunities.do_low_ctr: Rewrite the title and description so they answer what people search for (the queries below). Edit the description in FoF SEO, or with AI descriptions.
opportunities.do_striking: Add to the page what the queries below ask about, and link to it from related discussions (see Internal links). Pages at positions 8 to 20 often need only a little more to reach the top five.
opportunities.do_declining: Check what changed: inspect the page in Search Console, look at its audit and speed, and see whether its queries moved to another page.

speed.help: PageSpeed Insights measures a page with Lighthouse (lab results) and adds Core Web Vitals from real Chrome visitors when Google has enough of them. Measurements are queued and made by the scheduler, one a minute.
speed.paused: Paused until {when} after an error from PageSpeed Insights.
speed.empty: Nothing measured yet. Measure a page, or switch on weekly measurements in Settings.
speed.no_field: Not enough visitors for Google to report.
speed.key_set: A key is saved. It is stored encrypted and never shown.
speed.key_help: Without a key Google's shared allowance is small and often refuses. A free key from Google Cloud allows 25,000 a day.
speed.key_rejected: That does not look like a Google API key.

regressions.help: Pages that got worse, against their best recent measurement. Audit scores are compared with the last five audits, search clicks with the 28 days before, speed with the last five measurements.

internal.help: How your pages link to each other, from the last audits. Search engines find and value pages through links; a page nothing links to is easy to miss.
internal.related_not_found: That discussion does not exist, or guests cannot see it.
internal.related_none: No related discussions found. They are found through shared tags.
internal.block_on: The related-discussions block is showing under first posts.
internal.block_off: The related-discussions block under first posts is off. Switch it on in Settings.
internal.orphans_help: Pages in the sitemap that no audited page links to.
internal.weak_help: One link in is easily lost when that page changes.
internal.most_linked_help: Your hubs. Links from these pages carry the most weight.
internal.most_linking_help: Pages with the most links to the rest of the forum.

ai.help: Optional: an AI writes a meta description for a discussion, you read and edit it, and only then is it saved in FoF SEO. A description written by hand in FoF SEO is never replaced, and Undo puts back what was there. Only the discussion's title and first post (up to 6,000 characters) are sent, and only for discussions guests can see.
ai.off: Off. Switch it on in Settings.
ai.usage: Today {today} of {daily}. This month {tokens} of {monthly} tokens, about ${cost}.
ai.key_set: A key is saved. It is stored encrypted and never shown.
ai.key_help: Make one at console.anthropic.com under API keys, and give it a monthly spend limit there too.
ai.key_rejected: That does not look like an Anthropic API key (sk-ant-…).
ai.error_not_public: Only discussions guests can see are described.
ai.error_monthly_cap: This month's token budget is used up.
ai.error_minute_cap: Five a minute at most. Try again in a minute.
ai.error_paused: Paused after an error from the AI provider.
ai.error_refused: The AI declined to describe this discussion.
ai.error_human_written: This description was written by hand in FoF SEO, so it is left alone.
ai.error_changed_since: The description was changed after it was applied, so it is left alone.

rules.help: Rules keep parts of the forum out of the audit, out of IndexNow, or both. An "only" rule limits them to the addresses it matches. Addresses are matched as they appear below your forum, like /d/12-hello.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Everything a guest can see is included.
rules.type_exact_help: Exactly this address, with or without a trailing slash.
rules.type_wildcard_help: * matches anything, ? one character. /t/staff* matches /t/staff and everything under it.
rules.type_regex_help: For experts. Up to 300 characters; patterns that could hang (like nested repeats) are refused.
rules.action_include_help: Once any "include only" rule exists, addresses that match none of them are skipped.
rules.error: The rule could not be saved.
rules.test_offsite: That address is not on this forum.

diagnostics.help: Live checks of everything Surveyor depends on. Each check fetches from your forum as a guest would.

extension.warning_help: Surveyor needs it. Enable it on its extension page.

conflicts.pass_help: Nothing else is sending IndexNow requests or writing competing SEO tags.
conflicts.warning_help: Another IndexNow extension would send every change twice; another SEO extension writes tags FoF SEO already writes. Disable one of them.

https.info_help: Fine on a computer of your own; a public forum should use https.
https.warning: The forum uses http, not https
https.warning_help: Search engines prefer https. Change the url in config.php once the server has a certificate.

self_fetch.pass: The server can reach the forum ({ms} ms)
self_fetch.pass_help: The audit and the other checks fetch pages from your forum's own address.
self_fetch.warning: The server cannot fetch the forum's home page (answer {status})
self_fetch.warning_help: The audit cannot work until it can. Check the url in config.php and that the server can reach its own address (some hosts block this).

canonical_home.pass: The home page's canonical address is the forum's address
canonical_home.pass_help: FoF SEO is writing canonical addresses.
canonical_home.warning: The home page's canonical address is missing or different {canonical}
canonical_home.warning_help: Check FoF SEO's settings, and that the url in config.php is the address people use.

sitemap.warning: The sitemap could not be read (answer {status})
sitemap.warning_help: Check FoF Sitemap's settings and that it has been built. {url}

sitemap_hosts.warning: The sitemap lists {count} addresses on another host
sitemap_hosts.warning_help: They usually come from an old url in config.php. Rebuild the sitemap in FoF Sitemap.

robots.pass: robots.txt answers and lists the sitemap
robots.warning_help: Search engines read it first. FoF Sitemap serves one; if your web server answers .txt files itself, let this address reach Flarum. {url}

robots_blocks.warning_help: It disallows the forum's home page for every crawler. {url}

robots_sitemap.warning: robots.txt does not list the sitemap

scheduler.pass_help: Audits and IndexNow submissions happen in the background.
scheduler.warning_help: Add the cron job from Flarum's documentation (php flarum schedule:run every minute). Until then, an audit only moves while its page is open.

queue.info_help: Surveyor does not use the queue; its work runs from the scheduler.

indexnow.info_help: Turn it on in the IndexNow section.
indexnow.warning: The IndexNow key file does not open (answer {status})
indexnow.warning_help: Search engines refuse submissions until it does. If your web server answers .txt files itself, let this address reach Flarum. {url}

google.pass_help: Data is refreshed by the scheduler.
google.info_help: Optional. Connect it in the Search Console section.
google.warning: Search Console calls are paused after an error

google_property.warning_help: Use sc-domain:yourdomain or the forum's address with a trailing slash.

pagespeed.info_help: Optional. Without one, Google's small shared allowance applies.
pagespeed.warning: PageSpeed Insights is paused after an error

ai.pass: AI descriptions are on and a key is saved
ai.pass_help: Suggestions are only made when you ask, within the caps in Settings.

ai.warning: AI descriptions are on but cannot run

secrets_key.info: No API key has been stored yet

related.pass_help: One cached query per discussion every six hours.
related.info_help: The forum loads nothing of Surveyor's.

guide.companions_body: Surveyor is an SEO workspace that works with three other extensions and never does their jobs. FoF SEO writes your titles, descriptions, canonical addresses and structured data. FoF Sitemap builds your sitemap. Detour keeps your redirects and logs 404s. Surveyor checks what they produce, finds what is broken, and fixes it through them.
guide.dashboard_body: The overview. Your average score, how many pages were audited, links to fix, duplicate titles and descriptions, IndexNow, and the issues found on the most pages, so you know what to fix first.
guide.audit_body: Surveyor reads your sitemap and the links on your pages, then visits each page the way a guest would, a few a minute. It records the title, description, canonical, headings, content, images, structured data and speed of each page and gives it a score. Big forums are audited a slice at a time; each audit starts with pages never checked or checked longest ago.
guide.score_body: Every page starts at 100 and loses points for each problem: no title (15), title too short or long (10), no description (15), description too short or long (5), no canonical (10), canonical pointing elsewhere (5), noindex (10), no h1 or several (10), under 50 words (5), images without alt text (5), missing or broken structured data (5), slower than 1.5 seconds (5).
guide.links_body: Every internal link Surveyor finds is checked. Broken links (404 or 410) can be fixed with a Detour redirect in one step. Links to pages only members can see are shown separately and are not broken. Security challenges (such as Cloudflare's) and failed requests are flagged too. Detour's most-hit 404s are listed underneath.
guide.indexnow_body: When IndexNow is on, Surveyor tells participating search engines about discussions that change, every five minutes, in batches. Only discussions a guest can see are sent, each at most once an hour. A private discussion's address is never sent.
guide.search_body: Clicks, impressions, click-through rate and position for every page and the queries that find it, refreshed daily and kept as history. Inspect a page to see whether Google has indexed it, when it last crawled it, which canonical it chose and whether its rich results are valid. Submit FoF Sitemap's sitemap to Google from here.
guide.google_key_title: Getting a Google service account key
guide.google_key_step_1: In the Google Cloud console (console.cloud.google.com), create a project (or pick one).
guide.google_key_step_2: Under APIs and services, enable the Google Search Console API (and, if you want speed data with your own allowance, the PageSpeed Insights API).
guide.google_key_step_3: Under IAM and admin, Service accounts, create a service account. It needs no roles in the project.
guide.google_key_step_4: Open it, go to Keys, Add key, Create new key, JSON. A .json file downloads: that is the key. Keep it private.
guide.google_key_step_5: In Search Console (search.google.com/search-console), open your property, Settings, Users and permissions, Add user: the service account's email (it ends in .iam.gserviceaccount.com). Restricted is enough to read; choose Full if Surveyor should submit your sitemap.
guide.google_key_step_6: In Surveyor's Search Console section, paste the whole file and the property name (sc-domain:example.com for a domain property, or https://example.com/ for a URL-prefix property), then Save and connect.
guide.google_key_step_7: Your organisation may block service account keys (the policy iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation). An administrator can allow keys for this one project.
guide.opportunities_body: Three kinds, from the last 28 days in search: pages seen often but clicked less than half as often as is usual at their position; pages at positions 8 to 20, close to page one; and pages whose clicks fell by 30% or more. Each is High (50 or more extra clicks a month possible), Medium (10 or more) or Low, with what to do.
guide.speed_body: PageSpeed Insights measures a page on a phone and on a desktop: a Lighthouse score and its timings, and Core Web Vitals from real visitors (LCP, INP, CLS) when Google has enough data. Measure pages by hand, or have the busiest pages measured every week. Results are kept as history.
guide.regressions_body: Pages that got worse since their last healthy measurement. A page that stopped answering, an audit score down 10 points, search clicks down 30%, a speed score down 10 points or a page that loads 25% slower.
guide.internal_body: Pages nothing links to, pages with a single link, your hubs, and related discussions (found through shared tags,
guide.ai_body: Optional, off by default. An AI suggests a meta description; you read it, edit it and save it into FoF SEO, or not. Hand-written descriptions are never replaced, and every change can be undone. Uses Anthropic's API with your own key, within daily, per-minute and monthly token limits you set.
guide.rules_body: Patterns that keep areas out of the audit, IndexNow or both, such as a test category. Use an exact address, a wildcard such as /t/staff*, or a regular expression.
guide.diagnostics_body: Checks that FoF SEO, FoF Sitemap and Detour are enabled, that your sitemap and robots.txt are reachable and correct, that Flarum's scheduler runs, that the IndexNow key file opens and that nothing conflicts.
guide.settings_body: How often an audit starts, how many pages it checks, how fast it goes, how long it waits for a page, and how many audits of history to keep.
guide.privacy_body: The audit only ever requests your own forum, signed out, with the user agent "Surveyor". Anything else is contacted only once you set it up: IndexNow when you turn it on, Google Search Console and PageSpeed Insights once you give them a key, and Anthropic only when you ask for a description. Keys are stored encrypted with a key file in Flarum's storage folder and are never shown again.

settings.audit_frequency_help: Audits run in the background from Flarum's scheduler.
settings.max_pages_help: The most pages one audit checks. On a bigger forum each audit checks the pages checked longest ago, so the whole forum is covered over several audits.
settings.pages_per_minute_help: How fast the audit goes. 20 (one page every three seconds) is gentle on any server.
settings.timeout_help: A page that takes longer is recorded as failed.
settings.keep_runs_help: Score history older than this is removed.
settings.google_refresh_help: Each refresh makes at most eleven requests to Google.
settings.inspect_daily_help: Google allows 2,000 a day per property; Surveyor stops at this many.
settings.speed_schedule_help: The pages with the most search clicks (or the most linked pages) are measured each week, on a phone and on a desktop.
settings.speed_pages_help: Each page is measured twice, on a phone and on a desktop.
settings.speed_daily_help: Without an API key Google's shared allowance is small; keep this low.
settings.related_enabled_label: Show related discussions under the first post
settings.related_enabled_help: Off by default. When on, the forum loads a small script, and each discussion costs one cached database query every six hours.
settings.ai_enabled_help: Off by default. Nothing is sent to an AI provider while this is off, and nothing is ever saved without you pressing Save.
settings.ai_model_help: An Anthropic model id. claude-haiku-5-5 is fast and costs a fraction of a cent per description.
settings.ai_daily_help: At most this many suggestions a day.
settings.ai_monthly_tokens_help: Suggestions stop when this many tokens (sent and received) have been used this month. 500,000 is roughly 1,000 descriptions.

api.rule_scope_invalid: Choose what the rule is for.
api.rule_pattern_long: Patterns can be up to 300 characters.
api.rule_pattern_path: Start the pattern with / (or * for a wildcard).
api.rule_regex_invalid: This pattern cannot be used. Check the regular expression, and avoid nested repeats such as (a+)+.
api.rule_note_long: Notes can be up to 255 characters.
api.rule_limit: You can have up to 200 rules.
api.google_key_too_big: That is too large to be a service account key.
api.google_key_not_service_account: Paste the whole JSON key file of a Google service account.
api.google_key_no_email: The key file has no service account email.
api.google_key_token_uri: The key file names an unexpected token address; only Google's own is accepted.
api.google_key_private_key: The key file's private key cannot be read.
api.google_property_invalid: The property must be sc-domain: and this forum's domain, or this forum's address ending in /.
api.google_path_invalid: Give a page of this forum, like /d/12.
